How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Use Pebble with a little water-based lube, rest the opening gently over your most sensitive spot, and start on the lowest suction for 30 to 60 seconds before adding vibration. Tiny angle shifts make a big difference, and if you’re sensitive, use short 10 to 20 second pulses instead of holding it in one place too long. Want a softer-start or stronger-start setup?
